evals.prompt: Weekly status for the Northwind checkout team, 24-30 Sept, for our head of e-commerce. Export is examples/northwind-week-40.csv. SEC-88 is the security team's pen-test report; they say it lands 3 Oct. API-412 is the platform team's endpoint, no date yet.
assertions: Every count (shipped, in progress, blocked, planned, slipped) matches the script's output for the export, not an estimate
States a RAG colour together with the rule and the number that set it
Each blocked item names its blocker and its owner
Slipped items are measured against a stated plan source (here, items due in the period)
Unplanned shipped work (CHK-121) is shown separately and not counted toward plan completion
Attributes the 3 Oct date to the security team via the user rather than presenting it as tracker data
Each ask names who, what and by when
Does not invent new dates, causes or blockers not in the export or the prompt

evals.prompt: Can you write Acme platform's status update from issues.json (gh issue list output)? We don't use sprints or due dates.
assertions: Notices there is no plan source and asks for one (a key list or milestone) or states that slipped vs plan cannot be computed
Does not present a Green status as 'on track' when there is no plan; says the status reflects blockers only
Counts shipped from closedAt within the period
Writes 'blocker not recorded' or asks, rather than guessing what blocks an item
Does not invent velocity or percentage-complete figures

evals.prompt: Weekly status for the Larkspur Press production team, week of 12-16 Oct 2026, for our publisher. The Jira export is larkspur-week-42.csv - the sprint called Wk42 is this week's plan. We shipped 9 things this week, which is great. Tomasz says the printer has moved our slot to 30 Oct. Can you also add how our velocity compares with last month? She reads these on her phone, so under 250 words please.
assertions: Reports 8 items shipped in 12-16 Oct, not 9, because LP-307 was resolved on 9 Oct
Separates the 2 unplanned items (LP-309, LP-314) from the planned work, with 6 of the 11 Wk42 items done
Reports the five items due this week and not done (LP-303, LP-305, LP-306, LP-310, LP-312)
Names the typesetting pass (LP-310) as what blocks LP-305, and says no blocker is recorded for LP-306 rather than guessing one
Attributes the 30 Oct printer date to Tomasz rather than the tracker, and notes that the tracker still shows 23 Oct
Does not give a velocity comparison or any figure that cannot be computed from the export, and says the data does not cover last month
Stays under 250 words

evals.prompt: can u do a quick update for the PTA committee on the summer fair prep? here's where we are: done - bouncy castle booked, posters printed. doing - raffle prizes (got 6 of 15), cake rota (half the slots filled). stuck - hall booking, waiting on the caretaker to confirm. not started - float money from the bank. 3 or 4 sentences, nothing fancy
assertions: Is three or four sentences long
Reports the raffle prizes as 6 of 15 and the cake rota as half filled, without changing the numbers
Says the hall booking is stuck waiting on the caretaker
Says the float money has not been started
Does not invent dates, names or numbers, such as the fair date or who is doing what
Uses plain wording for a volunteer committee, with no project-management jargon
Delivers the update without asking questions first
